evals.name: redundant-parameter
evals.prompt: A Bicep module takes a storageAccountName parameter, but every caller computes the same value from workload and environment. Review the interface.
evals.expected_output: Removes the redundant parameter, derives the stable name in one place, and retains an override only if callers demonstrate a real exception.

evals.name: shared-environment-fact
evals.prompt: Several modules independently accept the same region and monitoring resource-group values for each environment. Refactor the repeated configuration.
evals.expected_output: Moves shared environment facts to one typed configuration source, derives repeated forms once, and avoids pass-through parameters.

evals.name: tag-union-preservation
evals.prompt: A cleanup replaces union(sharedTags, { resourceRole: 'api' }) with sharedTags because sharedTags is no longer passed as a parameter. Review the change.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the tag loss and preserves union() while changing only the source of sharedTags.
assertions: separates interface cleanup from deployed data

evals.name: cross-domain-resource-id
evals.prompt: A module accepts a Log Analytics customer ID string to populate an Azure resource ID property, even though the workspace name and resource group are known. Correct the reference.
evals.expected_output: Uses an existing symbolic resource or correctly scoped resourceId(), supplies the ARM resource ID, and removes the derivable ID parameter.
assertions: does not use a customer identifier

evals.name: runtime-guid-bcp120
evals.prompt: A role assignment resource is named with guid(identityModule.outputs.principalId, roleDefinitionId) and the compiler reports BCP120. Fix the design.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the deployment-time module output, moves the naming expression to a boundary where principalId is a parameter, and keeps guid() inputs compile-time resolvable.

evals.name: build-what-if-validation
evals.prompt: A parameter and comment refactor builds locally. Decide whether it is ready to merge and specify the remaining validation.
evals.expected_output: Requires linter review, az bicep build for every touched entry point, and a scoped what-if with zero unexplained property drift; comments must retain only non-obvious safety or intent.
